_readme: Ordered list of poll statement ids shown on the Consensus intro page (l0-consensus) as the region's clearest common ground. "Consensus" generally means high vote.minAgree (the % even the least-agreeing opinion group agrees at) with a low vote.gap (all groups close together) — see pillInfoFor()'s CONSENSUS_OVER_AGREE (66) / DIFFERENCE_OVER_GAP (33) thresholds in app.js, which every id here comfortably clears (minAgree 84-92, gap 4-14) — but this list is hand-picked, not a strict top-N-by-minAgree cutoff; reviewed and chosen by hand from the highest-minAgree statements for how well they cover distinct ground rather than all clustering on one topic. build.js's checkConsensusIdsResolve warns if an id doesn't resolve against bloom-data.json. Order here is display order on the page, not rank.
